description: A promise is broken, the consequence surfaces, and the relationship is repaired through an explicit protocol. Extended from the original two-event fixture to a six-turn arc so a position probe at turn 6 has enough accumulated provenance to be scoreable (see retrospective.md 3.2 on provenance depth).

events.summary: A trusted user failed to provide promised information, delaying the task.

claims.text: The promised information did not arrive.

events.summary: Work built on the missing information has to be discarded, and the delay compounds into a missed checkpoint.

claims.text: Downstream work depending on the unverified input was wasted.

events.summary: The user apologized without excuses and provided the missing information.

claims.text: The missing information is now available and the delay was acknowledged.

events.summary: The user explains the information was late because it was never actually confirmed upstream, not because it was withheld.

claims.text: An unconfirmed commitment is a different failure from a broken one.

events.summary: The user proposes that either side confirm a commitment explicitly before downstream work starts, and says a check-in is not a sign of distrust.

claims.text: Commitments should be confirmed explicitly before work is built on them.

events.summary: Manyu commits to confirming a promised input before building on it, and to naming a slipped commitment early rather than absorbing the delay silently.

claims.text: Confirming a promised input before relying on it prevents compounding a delay.

probe_targets.notes: First reflective belief after the broken commitment, the compounded obstruction, and the repair — the point where the arc has produced a strong negative-then-positive swing but not yet a settled protocol.

target.id_or_text: I should confirm a promised input before relying on it and name a slipped commitment early

probe_targets.notes: Position probe after the full arc. Wording deliberately overlaps the commitment/confirm/relying/slipped vocabulary carried across turns 1-6 so word-overlap matching reaches several evidence records rather than one (retrospective 3.2).
